items.title: Banking stocks, high oil prices drag Indian markets lower
items.summary: Across Asia, markets were mixed, with South Korea rebounding 1.8% from last week's losses amid simmering concerns over excessive investments in artificial intelligence (AI). Taiwan fell 0.6%, while Indonesia tumbled 3.6% following a warning from index provider MSCI that it would downgrade the country from the emerging market basket.

items.title: Can Jio’s massive scale convert into superior returns?
items.summary: As investors weigh the country's biggest-ever share sale, the key question is whether Jio Platforms can convert its vast subscriber base into higher customer spending and better returns on capital.

items.title: Apple India in sweet spot as FY26 revenue crosses Rs 1 lakh crore, profit soars
items.summary: Apple India's revenue reached ₹1 lakh crore in FY26, reflecting a strong growth trend in smartphone sales. Revenue growth was noted at 31%, exceeding that of its competitor Samsung, which faced a decline. Net profit increased by 66% from the previous fiscal year, highlighting Apple's robust performance. The premium smartphone market saw significant growth, benefiting Apple due to its strong brand appeal.

items.title: Treasuries Fall as Tech Shares Rebound, Denting Haven Demand
items.summary: Treasuries fell as a rebound in US technology shares sapped haven demand for US government debt.

items.title: US stocks today: Nasdaq leads Wall Street gains as chip, AI stocks rebound
items.summary: US stocks ended mixed on Monday, with the Nasdaq leading gains as chip and AI-linked stocks bounced back after last week’s sharp selloff. Investors also tracked corporate earnings and fresh stock-specific moves, while concerns over AI spending and financing remained in focus.

items.title: RBI injects Rs 1 lakh crore as liquidity tightens before festive season
items.summary: On Monday, the RBI announced a Rs 1-lakh-crore variable rate repo (VRR) auction for the first time since late July after the weighted average call rate (WACR) at 5.67% on Monday, or 17 basis points higher than the repo rate of 5.50%. The central bank will conduct another VRR for Rs 50,000 crore on Wednesday.

items.title: China curbs spur push for local manufacturing
items.summary: India's government will consult stakeholders on measures to mitigate the impact of Chinese export constraints. China recently imposed new restrictions on heavy machinery, such as tunnel boring machines, set to take effect soon. Indian officials assert that there should be no significant slowdown in highway development despite these curbs. The domestic construction industry is becoming increasingly self-sufficient…

items.title: Finance Ministry to run financial inclusion campaign
items.summary: The finance ministry is launching a campaign to saturate financial schemes across various local bodies. This initiative will reach 2.70 lakh gram panchayats and urban local bodies throughout India. Banks are expected to organize camps for enrolments and Aadhaar seeding for key schemes. The campaign will also involve updating nominations in savings accounts and providing other financial facilities.

items.title: Indonesia Was Finding Its Feet. Then Came MSCI
items.summary: The latest blow to Indonesia, from MSCI Inc.’s warning it’s considering removing the country from its global indexes, couldn’t have come at a worst time. Southeast Asia's largest economy appeared to be finding its feet after a rocky few years. Now, it faces an exodus of international capital.

items.title: RBI tightens scrutiny of $1 billion-plus overseas investments amid rupee pressure
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is implementing stricter scrutiny on large overseas direct investments by Indian companies. Banks must now collect and present detailed information regarding these investments to the RBI. This initiative aims to prevent potential losses for both the companies and the Indian economy. The RBI's checklist requires banks to conduct thorough due diligence on the rationale behind each investment.

items.title: Hedge funds retreat from tech at fastest pace in a decade as AI trade weakens
items.summary: Hedge funds cut technology exposure at the fastest pace in at least a decade as the global AI trade weakened and tech stocks bore the brunt of last week’s selloff. Goldman Sachs data showed funds reduced risk sharply, although technology remained a major part of their portfolios.

items.title: Uneven rains may keep price of spices elevated
items.summary: Southern India is currently grappling with challenges in spice production, primarily due to uneven monsoon patterns and parched soil, which are adversely affecting harvest yields. Despite expanding cultivation areas, turmeric yields are predicted to plummet owing to unfavorable weather. Additionally, delays in red chilli sowing in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana could lead to surging market prices.

items.title: Why is Amazon threatening to axe 5,000 delivery jobs over Zohran Mamdani’s labour law in New York? What govt can do
items.summary: Amazon has warned that it could cut over 5,000 delivery jobs and close 15 New York City facilities if Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s proposed Delivery Protection Act becomes law. The bill would require direct employment of drivers, prompting concerns over job losses, delivery costs and worker protections.

items.title: Walmart seeks $2.5 billion from US bond sale, weighs first Canadian-dollar offering
items.summary: Retail giant attracts over $14 billion in demand for US debt as spending plans and funding diversification drive borrowing strategy

items.title: Jio Platforms IPO listing: Can Reliance overtake Tata Group as India’s largest conglomerate by market cap? Details
items.summary: A potential Jio Platforms IPO, valued at about ₹10.3 lakh crore, could lift Reliance Group’s combined market capitalisation to ₹28.35 lakh crore, overtaking Tata Group’s ₹25.92 lakh crore. Adani ranks third at ₹17.23 lakh crore, followed by HDFC Group at nearly ₹13.9 lakh crore.

items.title: Vinted Cracks Down on Looted Goods After French Riots
items.summary: Vinted, a secondhand online marketplace that counts France as one of its largest markets, has seen an influx of listings suspected to contain looted items after riots broke out across the country.

items.title: Jio IPO anchor book sees over 30x demand, draws record bids worth ₹2.5 trn
items.summary: Jio Platforms' ₹8,110 crore anchor book draws bids exceeding ₹2.5 trillion, with global investors, mutual funds and insurers competing for shares ahead of its ₹30,213 crore IPO

items.title: S&P Global flags potentially hidden AI debt at hyperscalers as AI spending surges
items.summary: S&P Global warned that hyperscalers could be carrying more AI related debt than currently visible through financing structures linked to data centres and smaller AI firms. Despite rising concerns around AI infrastructure debt, the agency saw no immediate need for rating changes, while flagging profitability and escalating investment as key risks.

items.title: Piramal Finance Q2FY27 results: Net profit zooms 67% to ₹545 crore
items.summary: Non-bank lender Piramal Finance on Monday reported a 67 per cent jump in net profit to Rs 545 crore for the September quarter, helped by core income growth and improvements in costs. The company's core net interest income grew 35 per cent to Rs 1,530 crore due to a 24 per cent growth in assets under management and a 0.35 per cent expansion in net income margin to 6.5 per cent. The cost-to-income ratio improved…

items.title: Punjab & Sind Bank Q2 net profit surges 40% to ₹412 cr on improved income
items.summary: Punjab & Sind Bank on Saturday reported a 40 per cent jump in net profit to Rs 412 crore for the second quarter ended September 30, helped by improved core income and reduction in bad assets. The public sector lender posted a net profit of Rs 295 crore in the same period of the previous fiscal. The bank's total income increased to Rs 3,747 crore in the second quarter from Rs 3,373 crore a year ago, Punjab & Sind…

items.title: Tonbo Imaging India IPO subscribed nearly 136 times, led by QIB demand
items.summary: The issue drew 55,24,267 applications, according to Chittorgarh data, with qualified institutional buyers subscribing 293.56 times and non-institutional investors 170.94 times

items.title: 'Indian startup ecosystem is on steroids' - Anand Mahindra shares what excites him most, says my salute to them
items.summary: Anand Mahindra praised India’s startup ecosystem, highlighting companies including Ethereal Machines, Pranos Fusion Energy and Scimplify. He said young entrepreneurs are developing advanced manufacturing, fusion and chemical technologies that could help India leapfrog stages of development.

items.title: India-New Zealand trade pact takes effect on October 20: How it benefits both sides | Key highlights
items.summary: India’s free trade agreement with New Zealand takes effect on October 20, offering Indian exports full duty-free access and targeting bilateral trade of about ₹35,000 crore by 2030. Key highlights of the pact here.

items.title: Just Dial Q2 profit declines 9.73% to ₹107.8 cr despite 13% revenue growth

It had posted a net profit of Rs 119.44 crore in the July-September quarter a year ago, according to a regulatory filing. items.summary: Gujarat emerges as the largest semiconductor hub, with six approved projects, including Tata-PSMC’s ₹91,526 crore fabrication plant.

items.title: Ireda Q2 net profit edges up at ₹554 crore, loan disbursements rise 31%
items.summary: State-owned Ireda has posted a marginal rise in its standalone net profit to Rs 554 crore for the September quarter, the company said on Monday. It earned a net profit of Rs 549 crore in the second quarter of the preceding financial year, the Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency (Ireda) said in a statement. items.summary: Chairman Vikas Oberoi says the developer is exploring land purchases and joint development agreements across Delhi, Noida and Gurugram, while some launches await regulatory clearances
